questions.question: Which nutrient is mainly responsible for providing energy to our body?
questions.explanation: Carbohydrates are one of the main sources of energy for our body.

questions.question: Which nutrient is needed for growth and repair of body tissues?
questions.explanation: Proteins are required for growth and repair of body tissues.

questions.question: Which of the following is a rich source of vitamin C?
questions.explanation: Citrus fruits such as lemon are rich sources of vitamin C.

questions.question: Which test is commonly used to detect starch in food?
questions.explanation: Iodine solution turns blue-black in the presence of starch.

questions.question: Which of the following is a source of dietary fat?
questions.explanation: Edible oils are an important source of dietary fats.
